title: ocs-rs: support-first optimum contribution selection
description: An exact, matrix-free solver for genomic optimum contribution selection (OCS), with active-set column generation toward a single coancestry cap, a closed-form per-support solve, and relationship products evaluated from genotypes. Numerical validation includes Clarabel and optiSel on tested instances and public genomic panels. A separate AlphaMate comparison evaluates the shared continuous relaxation; integer mating allocation is outside this solver's scope. Large-candidate scaling experiments use synthetic populations.
